smoothing.note: P(b3|b1,b2) = 0.4 * P_ml(b3|b1,b2) + 0.4 * P_ml(b3|b2) + 0.2 * P_ml(b3), with add-1 (Laplace) over a 256-byte alphabet for the unigram term, and maximum-likelihood (0 if unseen) for the higher-order terms. Rare n-grams below the count cutoffs are treated as unseen. This is a toy model, clearly labeled as such in the demo.
